{{Top|leg}}
A '''starburst plant''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|flower]]. [[ConJob]] grew them and sold them at his [[ConJob's Trifles|stand]] on the [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. He presented one to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
